## ITGiveawayOptions type

Optional giveaway flags accepted by [Ctx.startGiveaway()](./gramstax.ctx.startgiveaway.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITGiveawayOptions = {
    onlyNewMembers?: boolean | null;
    hasPublicWinners?: boolean | null;
    prizeStarCount?: number | null;
    premiumMonths?: number | null;
};
```

## Remarks

Passthrough for the remaining `sendGiveaway` flags; combination rules (for example `prizeStarCount` versus `premiumMonths`<!-- -->) are adjudicated by the Bot API, not validated here.
